comment: Had her for ANTH 360 too. She's a great teacher, makes the class really interesting, not a harsh grader. As long as you participate, know the gist of the conversation, and take notes  you'll do fine. There is a lot of reading but it's generally interesting. Would highly recommend her.
Organized, interesting readings, good discussions...excellent intro course...would love to have another class with her

She is so awesome. She is very nice, experienced, and an overall good teacher. She checks attendance every day and participation is important but she is not too harsh on you. For in-class activities if you didn't read or don't know the answer she will help you find it. Definitely suggest this class!
